summary: The inherited hypotheses and exact-cell sign conventions are used correctly. The centroid-cap arguments, including strict enlargement, the zero-support local-disk exclusions, the exact endpoint marginal identities, both Brunn-Minkowski inclusions, the W-star coefficient ledger, the bridge containment and quantitative substitution, and the endpoint/middle decomposition are all valid. Inequality (17) is stated only as the remaining conditional comparison and is not claimed to be proved.
